summary.headline: Crescent and Mean Conjunction
summary.text: Discussion of lunar months and the crescent moon, including the terms ghurrah for the first day and salkh for the thirtieth. Defines the mean lines of the Moon and Sun and their meeting as the mean conjunction in the zodiac.
